acceptance: A journey test: a document that cites a line past the end of a file fails the check, and the text names the citation and the next step
A citation that names its commit stays valid after the file moves on
fix: Design first, then review, then TDD. Add a check to evolve docs that reads each path:line citation in a changed document, and fails when the path is gone or the line is out of range. Decide how a citation names the commit it describes, so a landed change does not make an old claim false.
summary: On 2026-11-05 the docs review of three design sets blocked five rounds. Several faults were path:line citations that were wrong or went stale while main moved, and a person or a seat found each one by hand. A later round can always find one more, so a review of citations by reading does not converge.
title: A path and line citation in a document must be checked by a machine
